label: Individuated veracity actual attitudes and selected domain
term: genuine assertion and actual assent to individuated contents
definition: Attitudes σ Content supplies primitive Asserts and Assents for one speaker and individuated content in a fixed context. Asserts means genuinely putting this content forward as true on the speaker own word; Assents means actual judgment accepting that content. Neither is factive, sincere, logically closed, or invariant under truth-equivalence by definition. Domain predicates explicitly select the relevant content family; applicability and negation closure are separate premises.
note: Content identity is a parameter, not a completed metaphysical or psychological account. Tagged finite controls distinguish representation labels with identical truth conditions; applying those tags to real cognitive distinctions remains OPEN.
